subject: Project-aware session tree merged
body: PR #2 merged. Explicit project chats now belong under projects/<project-id>/sessions/<session-id>/session.json; standalone chats remain under sessions/<session-id>/session.json. Project scope must be explicit/trusted, never inferred from topic. Existing sessions need no migration. For ChatGPT, use updated CHATGPT_GLOBAL_BOOTSTRAP.md globally and CHATGPT_PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md with a stable unique PROJECT_ID per project.
